method.baseline: Original runAdventure, all earned power points, safe events, expected gear, no spending.
method.changes: Only one predeclared public-information armor decision per observed natural defeat before original retry.
method.model: Twelve identical attacks using the maximum pressure inferred from actually displayed settled retaliation and the same-turn public defense/reduction panel. Percentages are rounded to the existing comparison display precision. This does not recover ward absorption or special modifiers and is not an enemy raw attack or upper bound. Real after-survival regeneration order; no kill-time or future-dice simulation.
method.natural: All gameplay writes are original legal transitions. Candidate panels are pure read-only projections. The selector has no access to state, seed, RNG or future outcomes.
method.hashes: Only runId is normalized; every other state field remains in fingerprints.
method.sampleSelection: First natural combat at floor >=30, first death, first actual swap before/after, incomplete terminal. No unavailable sample is synthesized.
method.incomplete: The original failed policy remains a separate outcome. Exit 2 is retained when a candidate does not reach 400; no replacement seed or budget extension.

limitations: Four fixed offline seeds do not measure human win rate, represent all seeds or prove optimal balance.
The repeated-pressure model is a heuristic, not a bound or promise: omitted conditional effects and enemy changes may make its values optimistic or pessimistic.
The model ignores outgoing damage. After legal gear changes, kill timing, later RNG, rewards and routes may diverge naturally.
No shop, forge, fusion or respec value is measured. This experiment spends exactly zero coins.
Node natural reachability and exact codec checks are not physical GPU, browser UX, mobile, sound or human play validation.
